questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was okay to take MA level courses as a BA student

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: You need to be in class as they take attendance. Further your grades are often registered/assesed through out the whole year, and not just evaluated by an ending exam.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Chinese studies, Comparative Politics A, Social and economic development in the mediterranean, Heritage Tourism and Sustainable economic development, International Relations of Europe

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I liked Chinese studies as there was also Chinese students in the class, which gave a greater understanding of the dynamics in the Chinese society.
